Subject: Order form redlines + tax evidence request

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. We reviewed the draft order form and finance/legal at Polar have two things they need cleared before signature:

1) Commit cadence: we want the minimum-commit ladder moved to quarterly tranches instead of annual upfronts (see attached redlines). Can you confirm Redwood can invoice per quarter and tie usage to tranche releases?

2) Net terms & invoicing entity: procurement prefers Net45 to match our AP cycles. Also need confirmation of which Redwood legal entity will be invoicing (US vs. UK entity) — that affects VAT/withholding for us.

3) Tax residency: please provide your W-9 or equivalent tax residency certificate so our tax team can complete the withholding assessment. I attached what we have (Tax_Certificate_PolarHealth.pdf) and our redlined order form (Polar_OrderForm_Redlines_v2.pdf).

We'd like to get final commercial alignment this week if possible. Can you route Redlines to internal finance/legal and let me know the likely timing?

Best,
Elena Morales
Director, Procurement
Polar Health

Thanks for the loop, Grace. Quick notes from Legal/Finance after an initial pass:

1) Commit cadence / quarterly invoicing: OK in principle. We will need clear acceptance criteria per tranche so we can automate invoice triggers (suggest statement of work appendix or milestone table in the order form).

2) Net terms: our standard is Net30. We can consider Net45 as a tiered concession if the customer commits to an annual minimum or agrees to an upfront deposit for the first tranche. Alternatively, offer Net30 for the first 90 days post-activation and re-evaluate to Net45 thereafter pending payment history. Any permanent Net45 requires Credit Ops sign-off (2–3 business days).

3) Invoicing entity: Redwood can issue from our US invoicing entity for this contract, but tax residency and VAT treatment will require the tax certificate you mentioned. Please ask Polar to sign and return their tax cert and send any VAT registration numbers if applicable.

I've attached a short summary of redline impacts and recommended edits to the OF (OrderForm_Redline_Summary.docx).

Action items:
- Elena: please provide AP contact + PO template and return Polar's tax cert signed.
- Grace / Karthik: run credit for Polar Health and confirm if we can accept Net45 conditionally.
- Legal: if we add a milestone appendix, I can draft the clause language for acceptance criteria.

Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Operations | Redwood Inference

Grace / Kimberly — thanks for the quick turnaround and the suggested options. Quick responses from procurement/tax: 

- AP contact & PO: procurement@polarhealth.com (attaching PO template in a separate message).
- Tax certificate: we'll send a signed W-8/W-9 equivalent and VAT number by end of day tomorrow.
- Net terms: Polar is willing to accept your suggested compromise: Net30 for first 90 days then shift to Net45 pending payment history. They also agreed to an upfront deposit equal to 1 quarter's committed spend to reduce credit exposure.
- Milestone appendix: we'll accept a milestone table tied to tranche releases — we'd like an example appendix to review.

Can you confirm Redwood will issue initial invoices from the US entity and provide a sample milestone appendix by tomorrow morning? If we can get that, Procurement will aim to finalize and send the signed order form by Friday.
